jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Vi söker just nu en kvalificerad fritidsledare till vårt fritidsteam. Som fritidsledare på IES Sigtuna kommer du att arbeta med att leverera omsorg och stöd före och efter skoltid till våra elever i F-6 och ansvara för att undervisa i enlighet med den nationella fritidsläroplanen. Förutom att utföra ovanstående uppgifter kommer du också att ansvara för att ge specialiserat stöd till eleverna baserat på deras individuella behov. Vi söker personal som, precis som vi, tror på att ge eleverna möjlighet att förverkliga sin fulla potential, oavsett bakgrund. Du måste också vara kunnig och passionerad när det gäller utbildning och barn. Du ska ha verktygen för att skapa en lugn miljö och kunna inspirera eleverna. 

Du ingår i en arbetsgrupp som tillsammans planerar och utvecklar fritidsverksamheten. Du förstår vikten av att samarbeta med dina kollegor, upprätthålla rutiner och regler, se möjligheter, ta stort eget ansvar samt ha ett vänligt och respektfullt bemötande mot alla du möter i arbetet. Vidare måste du ha en god förmåga att skapa positiva relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och personal. Ytterligare egenskaper vi söker är att du kan arbeta strukturerat, men samtidigt vågar vara flexibel. Förmågan att leda i grupp för att motivera och skapa delaktighet är oerhört viktig. Du arbetar bra i team, men kan också ta egna initiativ.

Vi sätter barnet i centrum under hela skoldagen. Vi har en positiv inställning till elevers och kollegors förmågor och vi reflekterar ständigt över hur vi som vuxna tillsammans kan påverka den undervisning vi bedriver i en positiv riktning.

Den här personen bör vara behörig inom något av följande områden:

- Fritidspedagog
- Fritidsledare
- Fritidslärare
- Lärare mot fritidshemmet

IES Sigtuna är en internationell skolmiljö, därför är flytande kunskaper i både engelska och svenska meriterande.

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna är belägen i ett nybyggt grönområde i Sigtuna kommun och ståtar med den historiska och vackra staden Sigtuna. IES Sigtuna är en skola där varje elev blir sedd och hörd och där du får möjlighet att göra skillnad i deras liv.

Internationella Engelska Skolan är en verkligt internationell skola. Vi har personal och elever från hela världen som bidrar till en dynamisk internationell atmosfär. Våra skolor är tvåspråkiga med upp till 50% av undervisningen på engelska och följer den svenska nationella läroplanen.

Ansök nu och se till att ladda upp ditt CV och ditt personliga brev på vår IES Careers-webbplats.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

jobs.occupation: Teacher Librarian, Bladins International School of Malmö
jobs.description:
At Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM), we are looking for an enthusiastic Teacher Librarian to join our Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) in January 2027.
If you are passionate about inspiring a love of reading, developing information literacy and supporting learning in an international school, we would love to hear from you.
About Bladins International School of Malmö
BISM is an IB Continuum School in central Malmö, offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) to approximately 360 students from diverse nationalities and cultures.
As part of Bladins Foundation, a non-profit educational organisation, we provide a supportive, internationally minded learning environment where students grow into knowledgeable, caring and responsible global citizens.
The Role
As Teacher Librarian, you will promote reading, inquiry-based learning and students' research, information literacy and critical thinking skills across PYP and MYP.
BISM has two dedicated libraries, one for PYP and one for MYP. You will develop these as welcoming and inclusive learning spaces and work closely with teachers to support learning across the curriculum.
Key responsibilities include:

Developing and managing both school libraries and their print and digital collections

Promoting reading for pleasure through library lessons, initiatives and events

Teaching information literacy, research skills, digital literacy and critical thinking

Collaborating with teachers to support PYP units of inquiry and MYP subjects, with awareness of the curriculum across MYP

Supporting students' Approaches to Learning (ATL) skills, including ethical use of information, referencing and academic integrity

Ensuring resources reflect the school's international, multilingual community and diverse learning needs

Building positive relationships with students, colleagues and families and engaging with the wider BISM community

Contributing to school development and a welcoming library environment

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a qualified, proactive Teacher Librarian with a passion for literacy and student learning.
You are:

Qualified in library and information science, preferably with school library experience

Experienced in supporting children's and young people's reading, research and information literacy

Knowledgeable about children's and young adult literature and able to inspire readers of different ages

Skilled in inquiry-based learning and collaboration with classroom and subject teachers

Confident using digital library systems, educational technology and online resources

Inclusive, organised and able to manage library activities independently

A positive communicator and collaborative member of an international team

Committed to professional development

Experience with the International Baccalaureate (IB), particularly PYP and/or MYP, is an advantage. Understanding the IB philosophy, Learner Profile and Approaches to Learning (ATL) is highly valued.
As English is the school's working language, professional spoken and written English is required.
Why Join BISM?
At BISM, you will join a welcoming international community committed to students, colleagues and learning. We offer supportive colleagues, professional development, an IB learning environment and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference to students' development.
Employment Information
Position: Teacher Librarian  Employment type: Permanent employment, with a six-month probationary period  Working hours: Part-time (60%)  Start date: January 2027
Application
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. Please apply by 30 November 2026.
For more information, contact:
Kumari Nevill, Primary School Principal Kumari.nevill@bladins.se
We look forward to welcoming a colleague who shares our commitment to high-quality education, collaboration and student success.

jobs.occupation: Associate Senior Lecturer in Applied Geophysics
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
The Applied Geophysics research group is part of the Division of Geoscience and Environmental Technology at the Department of Civil Engineering and Natural Resources in Luleå University of Technology. The department consists of approximately 400 employees, and research is conducted in the fields of geoscience, geoengineering, mining, metallurgy and civil engineering technology. The department has well-developed collaborations with research institutes, industrial partners and governmental agencies. The environment at the department is open, dynamic and brings together researchers as well as students from all over the world. It is one of the world’s longest standing research groups continuously active in mineral exploration and geoelectromagnetic studies.
 
 
Subject description
 
Applied Geophysics includes studies of how the laws and methods of physics can be used to understand the properties of bedrock and soil deposits. This includes development and applications of methods for exploration and investigation of natural resources such as mineral deposits and water, as well as investigation of environmental and infrastructural related issues.
 
 
Duties
 
Applied geophysics covers a wide range of geophysical methods and the assistant senior lecturer is expected to have the ability, interest and willingness to contribute to teaching of relevant methods. Collaboration with teachers in other geoscience disciplines is an integral part of the duties. Research-based teaching is seen as important to maintain high quality and to be in line with new developments in applied geophysics. Therefore, the assistant senior lecturer is expected to participate actively in research projects.
 
 
These tasks means that you will:
Be responsible for developing, teaching and examining courses in applied geophysics, both at first and second cycle levels / at all study cycle levels. Supervise students and follow the subject's international development
Work with research tasks (e.g., applying for external research funding, leading and collaborating in research projects, data collection, communicating and disseminating research results via academic publications)
Network and collaborate with actors nationally and internationally
Be active in the applied geophysics research community.

Qualifications
 
To meet the requirements for the appointment as associate senior lecturer, the applicant:
must have been awarded a doctoral degree or must have a foreign degree considered equivalent to a doctoral degree. It must be within following areas:
Geophysics
Physics (with specialization in electromagnetism or computational physics) or a closely related numerically intensive discipline.

The candidate should have completed a doctoral degree no more than five years before the end of the application period. A candidate that completed the doctoral degree earlier may apply if there are special reasons such as leave due to illness, parental leave, clinical service of trust, or similar circumstances.
 
 
Assessment criteria
 
The following assessment criteria apply to this position:
scientific expertise
other assessment criteria.

Other assessment criteria is weighted equally:
ability to plan and perform geophysical fieldwork
the degree of expertise required for qualification
administrative proficiency that is of value in view of the subject matter and the duties included in the appointment
the ability to collaborate with the wider community
the ability to obtain external research and development funding
the ability to communicate research and development work
the ability to teach in Swedish and/or in English

Period of employment
 
This position is for an employment period of four years.
 
 
Promotion to senior lecturer
 
An assistant senior lecturer shall, upon application, be promoted to senior lecturer on a permanent position. That the applicant is qualified for a position as senior lecturer and is deemed suitable for such a position in an examination, is determined in accordance with the assessment criteria set out below:
 
 
In the examination, it is required that the associate senior lecturer has completed higher education pedagogical education corresponding to 7.5 credits or has acquired corresponding knowledge in another way.
 
 
During the employment period, the associate senior lecturer must also independently, to a considerable extent and with high quality, contribute to the university's research and demonstrate good pedagogical skills.
 
 
Information
 
You are employed by the university and the position includes salary and full social insurance. It is a full-time fixed term employment for four years with placement in Luleå.
 
 
For further information about the position, please contact Professor Maxwell Meju, +46 920-492261, mailto:maxwell.mej@ltu.se
 
 
For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Tradeunioncontacts

You don’t need data centre experience; our client is looking for someone with a background in logistics or warehousing who likes order and accuracy.

Receive incoming equipment, check it against delivery documents and register it.
Prepare and dispatch outgoing equipment.
Track inventory and keep stock records up to date.
Carry out regular stock audits and follow up on differences.
Stage equipment for installation teams.
Keep accurate records of everything that moves in and out of the site.

What you bring
At least six months of experience in logistics, warehousing, inventory management or similar work.
Accuracy and a structured way of working.
Comfort with inventory or warehouse systems.
Good English.

-Hourly wage: NOK 300 ( approx. 27,9 EURO per hour).

Does this sound like the right job for you? Get in touch with us!

Om bedriften
We are a supplier specializing in flooring and self-leveling screed. Among our staff, we have master craftsmen and floor layers with trade certificates, with up to 51 years of experience. We are an approved training company with our own apprentice employees.

Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and shaping the architecture of games played by millions?
As a Principal Server Engineer at Snowprint, you are part of a game team, designing, developing and operating the game. You'll combine hands-on development with long-term technical vision. Everything you do impacts the player experience and how we build games.
At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and taking ownership are what make great games possible. We work in small, cross-disciplinary teams where people are trusted to take responsibility, share ideas openly, and continuously improve how we build games together.
What you’ll be doing
Together with the team, you'll shape the architecture and technical direction of our backend systems, designing and implementing solutions that support both current game features and future needs. You'll take the lead on complex technical features.
You'll work on both player-facing features and the systems, tooling and infrastructure behind them. This includes evolving our existing architecture, identifying opportunities for improvement, and ensuring our backend solutions remain scalable, maintainable, efficient and secure as our games grow.
You'll also play an important role in the technical development of the team. Working closely with other developers, you'll share knowledge, challenge ideas, provide technical guidance and help establish good practices. You'll collaborate with designers and other disciplines to ensure that technical decisions support both development needs and the player experience.
Is this you?
You're a highly experienced server/backend engineer with a strong background in designing, building, and operating complex backend systems. You're fluent in Kotlin and/or Java.

You have experience shaping backend architecture and making technical decisions that balance immediate requirements with long-term scalability and maintainability.

You're comfortable taking ownership of cloud infrastructure and have hands-on experience operating cloud environments.

You have extensive experience with live services and understand the demands of keeping a game running. You're comfortable troubleshooting production issues, adapting to changing priorities, and finding solutions when things don't go as planned.

You're a strong technical voice who enjoys sharing knowledge, challenging ideas, and helping others grow. You communicate clearly, collaborate well and can explain complex technical decisions to people from different disciplines.

Where you’ll work
Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, and we work in a hybrid setup. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction, while other days offer flexibility depending on where you work best. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably both at home and in the studio.
About Snowprint Studios
Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment - while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance. For more information on Snowprint Studios go to snowprintstudios.com and follow us on Facebook.
At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace. Join us in shaping the future of gaming!

jobs.occupation: AI Lead Engineer | Early Career Program
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   About this opportunity    Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. 
  
 The Innovate track is designed for you who are driven by building what’s next. You’ll rotate across Research, Product Development, Data, and AI  contributing to solutions that don’t just support the business but move it forward. 
  
 This isn’t a programme where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. 
  
 Your journey within the Innovate Program will start as AI Lead Engineer within Business Area Networks. 
  
      What you will do    AI is not a side project in our R&D organization — it is changing how we design, build, verify and release products. We are looking for an AI Lead Engineer who wants to be at the front of that change from day one. Your mission is to investigate and transform how R&D works with the help of cutting-edge AI techniques. Concretely, that means:  
  Map and challenge existing R&D workflows and processes — from requirements and design through implementation, verification and release — and identify where AI creates real leverage. 
 Prototype and pilot solutions using modern AI techniques: large language models, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, code intelligence and automation of engineering toolchains. 
 Turn successful prototypes into adopted ways of working: measure the impact, document it, and drive towards large-scale AI development in the organization. 
 Act as a technical reference point for AI in your organization — sharing what works, being honest about what does not, and raising the AI literacy of the engineers around you. 
 Work across unit and country borders within RAN Services product development, regarding tooling, data and AI competence. 
  
 
 You will bring:
  Technically oriented, with an AI-first mindset: your instinct is to ask what part of this problem AI should solve before doing it by hand.  
 Hands-on with AI/ML in practice — through studies, thesis work, internships or personal projects.  
 You can code (Python or similar) and you are comfortable with modern AI tooling.  
 Curious and structured: You can break a messy, undefined process into something you can measure and improve.  
 You take ownership and follow things through to an outcome, not just to an idea.  
 You communicate clearly and can convince experienced engineers to change how they work.  
 Fluent in English.  
 You have a global attitude and willingness to relocate internationally for one 6-month rotation.  
  
 
 Note on the title: “Lead” here refers to leading the AI agenda and technical direction in your area, not to line management. Formal leadership experience is not required. 
   
 In addition, you have: 
  MSc or PhD (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics or related field.  
 Ability to develop strategies and prioritize activities. 
 Interest in experimentation and innovation with the ability to think creatively and be well adapted to change.  
 Knowledge of wireless communication, radio networks and AI & machine Learning. 
 Experience in software engineering or development with hands-on programming. 
 Solid networking, collaboration and communication skills and proficiency in English.  
  
 
 Pre-offer checks including references and relevant background screening will be conducted for final candidates.

jobs.description:
Har du ett kreativt driv och ett engagemang för att inspirera unga människor att uttrycka sig genom bild och skapande? Är du trygg i ditt ledarskap och brinner för att skapa en strukturerad, kreativ och stimulerande lärmiljö? Då kan du vara den vi söker! Internationella Engelska Skolan Hässelby Strand söker nu en engagerad bildlärare på heltid som vill vara med och utveckla elevernas kreativitet, visuella kommunikation och skaparglädje.  Om IES Hässelby Strand Internationella Engelska Skolan Hässelby Strand är en grundskola med en internationell profil där höga akademiska förväntningar, trygghet och respekt står i centrum. Vi är stolta över vår internationella gemenskap och den mångfald som präglar vår verksamhet. Hos oss arbetar vi tillsammans för att skapa en skolmiljö där både elever och medarbetare ges möjlighet att utvecklas och nå sin fulla potential. Mer information om IES och våra skolor hittar du på www.engelska.se.  Om tjänsten

 Vi söker en engagerad, kreativ bildlärare som kommer att arbeta hos oss 80% I rollen ansvarar du för att planera, genomföra och följa upp undervisningen i bild utifrån läroplanens mål. Du inspirerar eleverna att utforska olika tekniker, material och uttrycksformer samt utveckla sin förmåga att skapa, tolka och kommunicera genom bilder. Du skapar en trygg och inspirerande lärmiljö där eleverna får möjlighet att utveckla sin kreativitet, självständighet och tilltro till sin egen förmåga. Du blir en del av ett kollegialt sammanhang där samarbete, tydlig kommunikation och ett gemensamt ansvar för elevernas lärande och utveckling är viktiga delar av vardagen. Vi söker dig som 

- Har svensk lärarlegitimation med behörighet i bild för årskurs 4-9
- Har ett genuint intresse för bild, kreativt skapande och ungdomars utveckling.
- Är trygg i ditt ledarskap och kan skapa struktur, tydlighet och studiero i klassrummet.
- Har förmåga att planera och genomföra inspirerande och varierad undervisning.
- Kan introducera eleverna till olika tekniker, material och konstnärliga uttryck.
- Är relationsskapande och har lätt för att samarbeta med både elever och kollegor.
- Är ansvarstagande, flexibel och tar egna initiativ.
- Delar vår övertygelse om vikten av höga akademiska förväntningar och en trygg skolmiljö.

 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

 Vill du bli en del av vårt team? Vi ser fram emot att ta del av din ansökan! Ansök via IES Careers. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post. För att arbeta inom skolan behöver du kunna visa upp ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret som inte är äldre än sex månader. Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta [kontaktuppgifter till skolan]. Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

At Web Manuals, we’re redefining aviation with our state-of-the-art SaaS solutions.
Our mission?
To revolutionize how aviation professionals work while reaching new heights of innovation and service. As a bootstrapped company, we chart our own course, breaking barriers and setting our sights on the stars and beyond. With offices in Malmö (HQ), San Diego, New York, Singapore, Sydney and Barcelona, we are proud to offer an environment where you can soar, both professionally and personally, and explore a world of opportunities within an international team. Now, we are on the hunt for a Quality Coordinator to join our team in Malmö!
Take the leap and join Web Manuals on our journey to revolutionize aviation – apply today!
About the role
As Quality Coordinator at Web Manuals, you will work with our quality management system and help build a growth-enabled business based on continuous improvement. You will also play a leading role in our planned ISO 14001 implementation, helping us extend our management system into environmental management. Beyond quality, you will govern the full lifecycle of our supplier contracts, from evaluations and audits to negotiations and keeping our contract repository up to date. You will be the go-to person in the organization for supplier contract matters.
You will report to our General Counsel and work closely with our Information Security Specialist in the Legal & Compliance Team. Together you will manage audits and compliance reporting, and you will support our ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2 audits. You’ll also support our Commercial and Customer Success teams in answering RFP questionnaires where applicable. You will be the main contact for our certification body, customers and suppliers on quality matters, so clear communication and a collaborative approach will be key.
Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Ensuring compliance with ISO 9001.
Leading our planned ISO 14001 implementation, from gap analysis to certification.
Managing the Deviation Report Process, including following up on analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
Planning and conducting internal audits and management reviews, and managing customer and supplier audits.
Driving continuous improvement of our Management System, and publishing revisions of the Management System Manual.
Preparing monthly compliance reports, and contributing to our Annual Compliance Report.
Managing supplier contracts throughout their lifecycle, and keeping our Supplier CLM up to date.
Holding recurring quality meetings and training to build awareness of quality, the environment and supplier governance across the company.

What we’re looking for:
Post-secondary degree within a relevant field.
Previous experience with quality management or a similar role.
Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and the principles of management systems.

To thrive in this role, we believe that you have:
A structured, detail-oriented approach, and you’re comfortable maintaining controlled documents.
The ability to engage colleagues across the company in quality and continuous improvement.
Clear and professional communication skills in English, both spoken and written, as English is our corporate language.

Ideally but not required, you also have:
Experience from the SaaS and/or aviation industries.
Experience from auditing or contract management.
Experience from work or studies in an international environment.
A curiosity about environmental management and sustainability.

Other information
Start date: January/February
Location: Malmö
Work extent: Full-time, permanent
As part of our recruitment process, we use the Predictive Index (PI) assessment to ensure a great fit between your skills and our company culture.

Reports to: Primary Principal
Our vision
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.
Description/Purpose
A teacher at the Stockholm International School is responsible for the quality education of students in relation to the SIS curricula and programs of study. They work to stimulate and motivate students towards high academic performance and commitment to lifelong learning, as well as to prepare students for continuing education at SIS and other educational institutions.
A teacher at SIS is aware of and understands their importance for the academic development and psycho-social education of students. They support the students in their development as global citizens. They contribute to the school's ongoing development, and thus to the positive reputation of the school.
A teacher always keeps in mind the SIS motto: Valued, Challenged, Balanced, Prepared.
Duties/Responsibilities: 
To provide an excellent education for Primary students (Grades 1 to 5).
Contributing to the development and implementation of the curriculum.
Communicating regularly with parents. 
Be an active and contributing member of the School’s faculty. 
Participating in the full range of professional activities in the school. 
Actively contributing to the operational needs of the school. 

Preferred qualifications and attributes:
Teaching qualification
Experience as a teacher. 
Excellent communication skills in English, at a native speaker level. 
The ability to establish rapport with adults and students. 
The ability to plan collaboratively and work effectively in a team 
A pleasant and friendly personality. 
The ability to function effectively under pressure. 
The ability to show initiative and work independently.

It would be desirable for the successful applicant to have a working knowledge of an inquiry-based learning program, IB PYP or their equivalent. Experience working with students from diverse cultures and countries would be an advantage. 

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check, as well as a mandatory police background check for the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer:
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation.

Ending 26th February, 2027

Salary: 
Based on a salary scale.
Application:
Last day for applications: December 3rd, 2026. We only accept applications in English and from qualified teachers. SIS reserves the right to offer the position as soon as a viable candidate is found.
